objectives.text: 认识韩文字母由辅音、元音和音节块组成的基本结构。
objectives.evidence: Node2 explicitly places ㄱ and ㅏ inside one 가 shape; left/right applies only to 가, not all vowels.

objectives.text: 能辨认并朗读基础元音和常用基础辅音。
objectives.evidence: Unchanged Node3 guides six-vowel reading; Node5 adds 가 나 다 마 / 라 바 사 아 reading and silent onset ㅇ in 아. FULL denotes textual teaching coverage, not observed learner pronunciation or mastery.

objectives.text: 理解初声、中声、终声组成韩语音节的基本方式。
objectives.evidence: Node6 identifies medial vowel by role and contrasts 가 right-side ㅏ with 고 lower ㅗ; preserves 한 mapping. Node8 explicitly makes final consonant optional.

objectives.text: 能将基础辅音与元音组合成简单韩语音节。
objectives.evidence: Original four combinations and unchanged two practice questions remain; no automatic correctness/runtime claim.
